command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01','FW_01','FW_02'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){`$ec=[uri]::EscapeDataString('show running-config'); `$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$ec; `$u2='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$ec; `$a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1 -Method Get).output -split '\r?\n'; `$b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u2 -Method Get).output -split '\r?\n'; `$d=Compare-Object `$a `$b | Where-Object {`$_.InputObject -notmatch 'Last configuration change|uptime|[0-9]+w[0-9]+d|[0-9]+d[0-9]+h'}; if(`$d){Write-Output ('=== '+`$n+' ==='); `$d | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 300}}"
